name: Tonya The  Killer
detailed_description:
🎮 TONYA – STEAM GAME DESCRIPTION

“Who are you?”
“I don't know. But I'm here now.”
🧠 STORY

The world is broken. Lawless. Trustless.
And in the midst of this decay, a woman appears—Tonya.

Nobody knows where she came from. She never talks about it. All she wants is a place to rest, a town to call home. What she finds instead... is another broken system.

Tonya enters a dusty town ruled by a sheriff who claims to stand for justice—but whose actions say otherwise. At first, she helps him. She completes jobs, patrols the streets, and restores order. But cracks in the sheriff’s facade quickly begin to show.

Behind the badge lies control. Fear. Oppression.

Tonya starts working with the bartender instead—a once-respected figure who now trades in secrets and supplies. Through him, Tonya begins trading with other settlements, learning the web of corruption that holds the town in place.

Eventually, her goal becomes clear: Destroy the sheriff’s system from the inside.

This is not just a story of survival. It’s a slow-burning rebellion.
And Tonya is the spark.
⚔️ GAMEPLAY FEATURES

Third-Person Action: Fast-paced arcade-style shooting with tactical movement

Mission-Based Progression: Every mission pushes the story deeper

Trading System: Work with the bartender to interact with other towns

Relationship-Driven Choices: Your actions shift how characters respond to you

Pixel Art Graphics: Classic retro visuals paired with modern storytelling

Cinematic Dialogues: A deep story told with sharp, focused scenes and interactions

🌍 WORLD & ENVIRONMENTS

Explore a decaying frontier filled with:

Town Center – where your journey begins

Outskirts & Junkyards – hostile areas full of danger and resources

Trade Routes – for missions beyond the main town

The Bar – your safe hub for planning, dialogue, and upgrades

The world evolves as Tonya builds alliances, completes missions, and reveals secrets. The more you push forward, the more the town—and its people—change.
🔓 FUTURE SEASONS

Tonya is just getting started.

This first release covers Season One, centered around Tonya’s arrival and the fall of the sheriff.
But future seasons will:

Uncover Tonya’s mysterious past

Introduce new towns and major characters

Deepen the gameplay with crafting, choices, and evolving storylines

Expand the open world with new dangers and decisions


✊ WHO SHOULD PLAY TONYA?

Players who love deep, character-driven narratives

Fans of indie games with heart and atmosphere

Anyone who enjoys moral ambiguity, betrayal, and rebellion

Players looking for a short but rich pixel art experience with meaning

“Whose side are you on, Tonya?”
“My own.”
